title: Zuno Agent Definition (OKF v0.3 Markdown bundle frontmatter + Zuno extension)
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block of agents/<name>/agent.okf.md (ADR-0038: OKF v0.2 Markdown bundles, superseding the earlier agent.okf.yaml Kubernetes-style document). Per ADR-0005, Open Knowledge Format (OKF) v0.2 is the base representation for agent knowledge/context and portability: it is document-oriented, expressed as Markdown with YAML frontmatter, and fixes a small set of standard fields (type, title, description, provenance, verification, freshness, sources) any OKF-consuming tool would recognize. Per ADR-0006, Zuno defines a profile on top of bare OKF for runtime concerns (tasks, tool authorization, model routing hints, UI presentation) namespaced entirely under the `zuno` key, which OKF v0.2 explicitly leaves to implementers. Fields are annotated below as [OKF CORE] or [ZUNO EXT]. This schema is the Track E contract other consumers (frontend portal rendering, Agent Runtime's AgentRegistry - ADR-0039, MCP Gateway's agent-declaration check - ADR-0036, evaluation harness) validate `agent.okf.md` frontmatter against. Tasks are individual linked Markdown documents under agents/<name>/tasks/<task>.md - see zuno-okf-task-v0.2.schema.json - not inlined here.

okf_version.description: [OKF CORE] OKF envelope version this document conforms to.

type.description: [OKF CORE] Document kind. Always "agent" for agent.okf.md files.

description.description: [OKF CORE] One or two sentence summary of what the agent does, independent of any particular UI.

provenance.description: [OKF CORE] Who authored/maintains this bundle, for auditability (ADR-0038 Security considerations: provenance metadata must be preserved across ingestion).

verification.description: [OKF CORE] Whether this bundle's factual/behavioral claims have been through a formal verification process. "unverified" is honest for this demo repository - no such process exists yet.

freshness.description: [OKF CORE] Last-reviewed marker so a consumer can judge whether this bundle's content may be stale.

sources.description: [OKF CORE] External knowledge sources this agent draws on, if any are worth naming at the bundle level (per-task tool declarations, below, are the operative authorization surface - this is descriptive provenance, not a capability grant).

zuno.description: [ZUNO EXT] The Zuno profile: everything OKF v0.2 leaves unspecified that the Zuno Agent Runtime, BFF, portal and policy engine need at runtime.

name.description: Stable, unique agent identifier. Matches the agents/<name> directory, the Keycloak OIDC client prefix (<name>-frontend), and the agent_<name> entitlement group (ADR-0040).

status.description: Lifecycle status of this agent instance in the current release. `active` means a real Agent Runtime task graph, FE and BFF are deployed and reachable. `placeholder` means only this declarative definition and a reserved namespace exist (ADR-0007): the portal renders an access-gated "coming soon" tile and no FE/BFF Deployment is applied. See platform/architecture/agent-platform-separation.md.

tasks.description: Ordered list of task names this agent exposes, each resolved to agents/<name>/tasks/<task>.md (zuno-okf-task-v0.2.schema.json). A `placeholder` agent declares exactly one stub task with an empty tool list.

graph_shape.description: [ZUNO EXT] ADR-0342: name of the Agent Runtime LangGraph workflow shape (components/agent-runtime/app/graph/shapes/<name>.py) this agent's active workflow executes - e.g. "retrieve_reason_respond". Not enforced `required` here (this schema checks *shape*, not business rules, per app/registry.py's own convention): Agent Runtime's AgentRegistry fail-fast startup validation requires it once `status` is `active`; a `placeholder` agent has no runtime workflow yet (ADR-0007) and may omit it.

primary_task.description: [ZUNO EXT] ADR-0342/WP-33: which entry in `tasks` above this agent's chat route actually executes - required for GraphFactory to resolve the right task's prompt/allowed_tools/allowed_knowledge when two agents share one graph_shape (e.g. Comage reusing retrieve_reason_respond). An agent may declare more tasks than this (v1 catalog entries with no live route yet); this names only the one the shape is built against. Not enforced `required` here for the same reason as graph_shape - a `placeholder` agent may omit it.

rag.description: ADR-0039: RAG retrieval parameters consumed by Agent Runtime's retrieve node - config, not code, so changing this changes runtime behavior without a source change.

top_k.description: Number of RAG results the retrieve node requests per turn.

memory.description: ADR-0215: conversation-history behavior consumed by Agent Runtime's record_history node - config, not code, so tuning history/compaction behavior changes runtime behavior without a source change. Entirely optional; every field defaults in app/registry.py when omitted.

history.description: Per-turn conversation history carried into this agent's model prompt, with budgeted compaction of older turns into a running summary.

enabled.description: Whether this agent carries conversation history into its prompts at all. Defaults true; the ZUNO_HISTORY_DISABLED env var can additionally force this off fleet-wide regardless of what any bundle declares.

max_turns.description: Number of most recent user/assistant turn pairs kept verbatim in the prompt after compaction. Older turns are folded into the running summary instead of being dropped.

token_budget.description: Approximate token budget (character/4 heuristic, see app/graph/history.py) for the running summary plus verbatim history combined. Must leave headroom for this agent's system prompt, RAG context and generation - sized against the NARROWEST context window this agent's chain can reach, not the widest: the fleet-wide default qwen3.5-9b serves --max-model-len=8192, while qwen3.6-27b-instruct, gpt-oss-20b and qwen3.5-9b-wesh serve 32768 (gitops/charts/models/values.yaml). A budget sized against 32768 overflows whenever the chain falls back to the default model, which almost every chain can.

project_context.description: ADR-0527: the standing engagement context of the project a conversation belongs to, injected into this agent's prompt as a delimited BACKGROUND block - never as instructions, so a user-editable field can never rewrite the task prompt this bundle declares (ADR-0039). Entirely optional, exactly like `history` above.

enabled.description: Whether this agent carries its conversation's project context into its prompts at all. Defaults true.

token_budget.description: Approximate token budget (the same character/4 heuristic as history above, app/graph/history.py's truncate_to_token_budget) for the injected project context. Separate from the history budget on purpose, so a long engagement briefing can never crowd out the conversation itself. The project's 54000-character storage ceiling is an INPUT limit; this is what actually reaches the model.

model.description: Model routing hint consumed by the AI/Inference Gateway (ADR-0009, ADR-0021): the data-classification ceiling this agent's tasks operate under, not a specific model name.

preferred_classification.description: Highest data classification this agent is routed for. C1: SaaS model use allowed. C2: SaaS allowed with restrictions/context filtering. C3: local models only. See policies/data-classification/README.md.

notes.description: Optional free-text routing guidance (e.g. sovereignty constraints on a subset of tasks).

local_only.description: ADR-0416: unconditional, agent-declared restriction to local models only, regardless of what preferred_classification alone would otherwise permit - mirrored at the routing layer by the graph's own per-turn local_only_required flag (ADR-0035). Optional - absent means false. Documented here because it was already in real use (agents/finage/agent.okf.md), read by registry.py, with no schema entry for it - this schema is a documentation contract, not something anything runs jsonschema.validate() against today, so the gap was silent rather than a validation failure, but additionalProperties:false still meant the schema was actively describing a shape Finage does not have.

access.description: Authorization gate consumed by the portal and BFF: which Keycloak entitlement group may open this agent's tile / call its BFF (ADR-0040 - orthogonal to the business-role groups that gate tool/data permissions inside an already-authorized agent, see policies/tools/tool-policy.yaml).

groups.description: Keycloak `zuno` realm agent-entitlement groups (JWT `groups` claim, e.g. "/agent_tekos") authorized to use this agent. One group per agent for v0; the schema allows more than one for forward compatibility.

ui.description: Presentation metadata the portal frontend uses to render this agent's tile, independent of whether the agent is active or placeholder.

displayName.description: Short name shown on the portal tile (may differ from the bundle's fuller `title`).

tileDescription.description: One-line description shown under the tile title.

color.description: Hint for the tile's accent color. A CSS color keyword or #rrggbb hex value.

icon.description: Hint for the tile's icon: a short keyword the frontend maps to a PatternFly/pf-icon glyph (e.g. "code", "currency", "drafting-compass", "handshake", "calculator"). Not a URL or file path.

models.description: ADR-0579 clause 2: model preferences by architectural ROLE (policies/models/model-catalog.yaml `role`), never by model name. The ai-gateway keeps the final choice among the models eligible for the effective classification.

preferred.description: Roles to try first, in order.

guardrails.description: ADR-0579 clause 3: how guardrail detections act for this agent; at least the corp minimum for its classification (policies/guardrails/guardrails-policy.yaml).

categories.description: Detection categories this agent cares about; a subset of the corp list.

limits.description: ADR-0579 clause 4: per-agent (or per-task) bounds, each at most the corp ceiling in policies/limits/limits-policy.yaml.

max_tokens.description: Generation ceiling per model call (ADR-0544); the task-level zuno.max_tokens stays valid as an alias.

max_concurrent_requests.description: Concurrent requests one user may have open on this agent.

memory.description: ADR-0579 clause 4: conversation history (ADR-0215); zuno.memory stays valid as an alias. ADR-0215: conversation-history behavior consumed by Agent Runtime's record_history node - config, not code, so tuning history/compaction behavior changes runtime behavior without a source change. Entirely optional; every field defaults in app/registry.py when omitted.

delegation.description: zuno-demo ADR-0406: bounds on delegation chains this agent takes part in, at most the corp ceilings in policies/limits/limits-policy.yaml.

max_depth.description: Maximum number of delegation hops starting from this agent (default 1: it may call a target, the target may not call anyone). At most the corp `max_delegation_depth`.

delegation.description: zuno-demo ADR-0401 (ADR-0579 amendment 2026-10-24): the agents this agent may delegate to over A2A, each a {agent, task}. Absent means no delegation. Never inferred; every target must exist in the release and be `active` when called.
